courses.name: Machine Learning
courses.description: Introduces supervised and unsupervised learning, model generalization and tradeoffs, with methods including trees, neural networks, probabilistic models and instance-based learning. Applications include vision, interaction and computational science.

requirements.title: AI core
requirements.summary: Take Machine Learning and Deep Learning. Only Machine Learning has a verified course-code match in the inspected public schedule.

requirements.title: AI applications / embodied AI
requirements.summary: Select two CS courses at the 3000 level from the AI Applications / Embodied AI cluster; the eligible pool is not enumerated in this source.

requirements.title: AI ethics
requirements.summary: Take one AI ethics CS course at the 3000 level; it may also satisfy the BS Social Ethics cluster.

requirements.title: Senior capstone
requirements.summary: Complete the four-credit capstone, available to seniors in spring. Its course code and credit-unit convention are not verified.

requirements.title: CS major overlap
requirements.summary: The concentration is for CS students. Courses may count for both the CS major and concentration without a stated double-count limit.

requirements.title: Mathematics preparation and advising
requirements.summary: Some courses may need linear algebra or multivariable calculus. Consult the CS department for current offerings and individual prerequisites.

notes: The requirement outline is mapped, but approved application and ethics course pools and the capstone code remain unverified. This is partial curriculum evidence, not a graduation audit.

The public Fall 2026 feed confirms the exact Machine Learning title/code match. Other AI-related course titles are not assumed to belong to the approved cluster. The Spring 2027 feed was also inspected; no exact Deep Learning match was found, which does not establish that the course is absent.
Published credit numbers are retained with unknown unit; no semester-hour conversion is inferred. Individual prerequisite strings remain unknown where not sourced.

2026-10-11: Re-read the AI accordion, department Courses/FAQ and official Fall 2026/Spring 2027 course feeds. The AI section supplies no linked finite cluster list. Spring CSCI 3334 AI and Ethics and other AI-related titles are candidates only: course titles do not establish the approved concentration pool. Exact Deep Learning and four-credit AI capstone identity were not found in the two inspected term feeds; this is not a course-absence claim. Department confirmation remains necessary.
